content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MNNIT Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at MNNIT Allahabad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Junior Research Fellow position at MNNIT Allahabad is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.E./M.Tech. or B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering or allied relevant branches, and must be GATE qualified.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000.00 per month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email to the specified address along with all required documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 523/R&C/2026-27.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is MNNIT Allahabad located?
faq.answer: Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology, Allahabad is located in Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 211004.

faq.question: Q10. What is the project for which the Junior Research Fellow is being recruited?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the project 'Design and Development of Block-Chain Enabled Secure and Bio-safe NFMI-based Wireless Body Area Network (SB-NFMI-WBAN)'.
